faq.question: How much does double glazing cost?
faq.answer: As a guide based on typical UK market rates, a standard casement window runs from around £350 to £900 installed, sash windows from around £600 to £1,100, and bay windows from around £1,200 to £3,200 depending on size - prices vary by region and specification. Compare free quotes to get an exact figure for your property.

faq.question: Is this service really free?
faq.answer: Yes, comparing quotes through us is completely free for homeowners. We're funded instead by a referral fee paid by installers when they receive a quote request, which keeps quotes unbiased since there's no incentive to push one installer over another.

faq.question: Are your installers FENSA registered?
faq.answer: We only accept vetted installers into our network, and FENSA registration is one of the criteria we check for.
